ROUTE::clear <destination IP address>
Purge the cache on all CMPs for matching connections to the given
destination IP address (i.e., if nexthop isn’t specified, it will
erase entries for different nexthops as well)
ROUTE::clear <destination IP address> <gateway IP address>
Purge the cache on all CMPs for matching connections to the given
destination IP address reached through the given gateway.
